ECR standalone batch/item storage has expected1–1000 bound, one client item per batch, durable leases/source/outcome/tokenmetadata and tenant cascades. This early schema lacks fullstate/counter domains later added by0108; no falsecurrentvulnerability from early declaration.

Opt-in passport back-page ECR stores durable generation/source digest/lease/retry state and constrained statuses/results with due index. Runtime generation fencing/provider retry safety belongs actual worker/caller contracts; parent/brand frozen runtime untouched.

Frozen0108 source adds same-group/agency passport composite FK and standalone ECR state/result/count/outcome checks. Preflight counts offending rows and aborts rather than reassign/delete; NOTVALID thenVALIDATE enforces newwrites and retainedrows. Local5slock/120sstatementtimeouts, no real Postgres execution. This narrows earlier passport ownership obligation but does not imply every unrelated earlyFK has equivalent later strengthening.

Durable dashboard session family cutover preserves old refresh rows as revoked tombstones, sets one lineage row per old token without guessing family, then enforces same-user compositeFK/non-nullsessionid. Explicit one-login cutover; native sessions/password/MFA untouched. Current revocation/rotation logic not exercised by source reading.

Transactional trigramindexes use frozen expressions and public pg_trgm, preserve existing rows and never drop shared extension on downgrade. Explicit release requirement to quiesce writers;5slock/120sstatement limits. This is not online/zero-downtime claim and no extension/DB invocation occurred.

Statement transition-table triggers coalesce affected groups in sorted order and increment roster revision through nonrecursive BEFORE-group trigger; covers passport/manager/coordinator source tables, preserves business data. Actual PostgreSQL trigger execution/deadlock/cache behavior requires integration proof.

Adds cover image types to crop/library checks; downgrade obtains exclusive locks and refuses if cover history exists before narrowing, preventing concurrent data loss. Parent image runtime unchanged; no sourcehistory deletion.

Adds false-by-default manual follow-up flag independent of passportstatus. Downgrade locks and refuses while any flagged work remains rather than silently discarding it; actual application UI/state proof independent.
